description:
💰 THE income screener — "which stocks pay a high / reliable / growing DIVIDEND?" Ranks the DIVIDEND-PAYING
    universe (all payers, not just news-covered) and hands you the raw pieces to tell a real income name from a YIELD
    TRAP (don't trust a headline yield).
    🔴 A multi-metric ask that also needs P/E / financial-health (dividend AND low P/E AND healthy) belongs in
    screen_unified (a `fundamental` leg + `dividend_min_streak_years`/`dividend_min_cagr` gate). THIS tool is the
    dividend specialist (no P/E filter) but it both INCLUDES (`gics`) and EXCLUDES (`exclude_gics`) a sector.
    Scope (country/gics) is OPTIONAL — omit both for a fast whole-market rank.
    🔴 `no_cut_streak_yrs` is a bounded RELIABILITY signal, capped at 10 (clean across the tracked decade incl. 2020/
    2022 stress) — NOT the dividend's full age; never state a multi-decade "aristocrat/king" streak, say "clean 10y+".
    Each row's `dividend` block decomposes the yield: `yield_pct` (forward/sustainable — quote this), `yield_trailing_pct`
    (>> yield_pct ⇒ a special inflated it), `payout_ratio` (>1 = unsustainable), `ttm_div_yoy_pct`, `no_cut_streak_yrs`,
    `last_cut_year`, `cagr_5y_pct`, plus `week52_high/low` + `pe_ratio`/`pb_ratio`/`eps` + a `news` block. 🔴 Never rank on
    yield alone: high yield + recent `last_cut_year` + negative yoy + high payout + bad news = TRAP; high yield from a
    price drop + intact/growing dividend + long streak = possible VALUE. Read the payload's `_guide`. limit default 15 (max 50).

country.description: Market filter — CSV of ISO-2 codes (e.g. `US` or `CN,TW,HK`). 🌍 If the question names a NATIONALITY or REGION ('European','Thai','Chinese','ASEAN'), put it HERE — never leave it inside a concept/`q`/`gics` field. Enumerate a region into its member ISO-2s yourself (Europe→GB,DE,FR,IT,ES,NL,CH,SE; ASEAN→TH,SG,MY,ID,PH,VN).
country.title: Country

exclude_gics.description: OPTIONAL — EXCLUDE a sector/industry from the screen (GICS code prefix e.g. '4010', OR plain English 'banks' — the server resolves the name). 'high-yield stocks but NOT banks' = exclude_gics='banks'. A stock with no GICS classification is KEPT.
exclude_gics.title: Exclude Gics

gics.description: A GICS sector/industry — a CODE PREFIX (sector `25` / group `2550` / industry `255010` / sub `25501010`, CSV for several) OR plain English ('banks', 'semiconductors', 'biotech'); the server resolves it. 🔴 ENGLISH (translate the concept first: ธนาคาร→'banks'). So 'European banks' = gics='banks' + country=EU codes.
gics.title: Gics

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

max_payout.description: Max payout ratio — 'high yield but payout NOT stretched'. Fraction (0.7) or percent (70).
max_payout.title: Max Payout

max_yield.description: Max yield % — guards against trap-tier yields.
max_yield.title: Max Yield

min_streak_years.description: Min no-cut streak years (0–10; caps at 10 = clean across the whole tracked decade). HIGHER = more reliable. A low bar lets a name that CUT recently through — it may have only rebuilt a short streak since its `last_cut_year`, so a short streak ≠ 'stable'. The stronger the 'safe / stable / hold-for-years' intent, the closer to the cap you should set it.
min_streak_years.title: Min Streak Years
